pretreatments.description: Organosolv pretreatment using ethanol (50% or 75%) with or without H2SO4 catalyst at temperatures of 120°C, 140°C, or 180°C for a duration of 60 minutes, followed by filtration, washing with 50% ethanol, drying at 40°C for 2 days, and solid recovery.
Enzymatic hydrolysis of the recovered solids using a mixture of Cellic CTec2 and Cellic HTec2 enzymes at 45 ± 1°C for 72 hours, followed by sugar concentration analysis.
